tools.name: evaluate_trade
tools.description:
Pre-trade risk check for a proposed trade. Call this BEFORE executing
any trade and treat a "deny" decision as a hard stop.

Evaluated at a fixed Tier 1 ceiling ($5,000 notional). For higher
limits, use `evaluate_trade_paid` (Tier 2, $25,000) which settles an
x402 payment on-chain.

tools.name: evaluate_trade_paid
tools.description:
Pre-trade risk check gated by an x402 payment. Evaluated as COLR
Tier 2: $25,000 notional ceiling, 10/25 per-minute rate limits.
No COLR holdings are required — the on-chain payment is the
credential.

tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description:
Honeypot / contract safety check for any ERC-20 token.

Returns a severity classification (safe / warn / danger), the specific
risk factors detected, and the result of a simulated sell. When
severity=danger, the next `evaluate_trade` for the same contract is

tools.name: simulate_balance
tools.description:
Simulate a wallet's ERC-20 balance after a hypothetical trade using
eth_call state override. Read-only: no transaction is ever sent.

tools.name: get_supported_assets
tools.description:
List every asset in the guardrail's official Robinhood Chain registry,
with its canonical contract address.

tools.name: verify_audit_trail
tools.description:
Verify the tamper-evident audit trail for a wallet's past guardrail
decisions.
